description: Perimeter access control, CCTV coverage of all common areas, and trained security staff on rotating shifts.
Temperature-controlled rooftop pool on the 22nd floor with skyline views, open to residents year-round.
Dedicated fitness floor with cardio and weight-training equipment and a separate ladies' hours schedule.
Redundant elevator banks sized for peak-hour traffic across the tower's 22 floors.
100% load backup generators covering all apartments and common areas during outages.
On-site mosque within the tower complex with separate prayer area for women.
Landscaped central park with jogging track, seating areas and children's play zones shared by all blocks.
Boundary wall with manned entry/exit gates and CCTV at key junctions throughout the community.
All utility lines run underground for uninterrupted street aesthetics and reduced outage risk.
Central mosque serving all sectors of Emerald Gardens.
Marked visitor parking bays along internal roads separate from resident driveways.
Shared rooftop deck with seating and skyline/sea views across both towers.
In-house retail podium with grocery, pharmacy and cafe outlets for residents.
Separate adult and children's pools on the podium level with lifeguard coverage during operating hours.
Access-controlled lobbies, CCTV-monitored corridors and manned security desks per tower.
Full-load backup generators for all residential floors and common areas.
Three-level basement parking with allocated bays per unit.
Independent lobby and elevator access for office suites versus residential floors to manage traffic.
Building-wide CCTV coverage monitored from a central security desk.
Shared meeting rooms and a business lounge available to office-suite owners.
Backup power for office floors and residential units during load-shedding.
Dedicated parking floors for both office and residential occupants.
Phase 1 boundary wall and gated entry completed; Phase 2 wall under construction.
A 4-acre park is being developed at the center of Phase 1, targeted for completion alongside road works.
Underground electric supply and Sui gas connections provisioned for Phase 1 blocks.
Central mosque construction underway in Phase 1, expected completion alongside possession.
Shared rooftop hall available for booking by residents for family events.
Ground-floor security desk with CCTV covering the lobby and parking area.
Generator backup for lobby, elevators and corridor lighting during outages.
One covered parking bay allocated per apartment unit.
Boundary wall completed in developed blocks; later blocks fenced as development progresses.
Piped water supply operational in possession-ready blocks.
Central park planned adjacent to the main commercial area, part of later development phases.
80-foot main boulevard with solar street lighting connecting all blocks.
Entry/exit monitored by CCTV and manned security at ground level.
Operating food court on the top floor with multiple F&B tenants.
Full backup power for common areas, elevators and shared signage.
Dedicated service elevator for goods/deliveries separate from customer-facing elevators.
